info.name: Friend & Family (FNF) API
info.description:
User Service – Friend and Family endpoints. Legacy-compatible request bodies.

**Auth:** Use Bearer token (Cognito JWT). When `organizationID` or `userID`/`userId` are omitted in the body, they are taken from the authorizer (`custom:organizationID`, `custom:userID`).

**Base URL:** `{{baseUrl}}` (e.g. https://xxx.execute-api.region.amazonaws.com/dev)

**Relation:** Accepts "Family" or "Friend" (case-insensitive).

request.description: Search for a user by email or phone to add as friend/family. **organizationID** and **userID** can be omitted (from JWT). Requires either `email` or `phone` (can send empty string for one). `relation`: "Family" or "Friend". When relation is Family, `relationship` is required. Optional: `roles`, `manageHealth`.

Add a member as friend or family. **organizationID** can be omitted (from JWT). **userId** can be omitted if provided by authorizer. `relation`: "Family" or "Friend". When relation is Family, `relationship` is required. Optional: `manageHealth`.

Update an existing friend/family member. **organizationID** can be omitted (from JWT). **userId** from authorizer. Required: `memberId`. Optional: `fullName`, `relation` ("Family"|"Friend"), `relationship`, `emergencyContact`, `manageHealth`.
Fetch invitees and inviters (friend/family list) for the given user. **userId** can be omitted if provided by authorizer.
Remove a friend/family member. Required: `userID`, `memberID`. **organizationID** is optional.
